name: Koi Doki
source:
Yuzuru is like any male student: he wants to be popular and do it with a girl. He talks about sex with his classmates and has perverted fantasies when he looks at cute girls. He chooses his wardrobe carefully and reads books about sex and watches AVs to prepare for the moment when it appears. Even though he’s been marked as a troublemaker by the public moral committee’s Suzuka, it’s still an enjoyable school life to him. He doesn’t feel lonely at home while his parents are away overseas since his younger sister Kokoro is always there to greet him with a smile.

One day, he helped a girl who claimed to have come from the future, Miku. She gave him a ring and told him to wear it if he wanted to become popular. Indeed, his life changed upon wearing it, with all girls in the school falling for him, including Suzuka who had considered him as an enemy.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/06/11/june-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
结弦就像所有的男学生一样：他想受欢迎并和女孩一起做。他与同学谈论性，并且当他看到可爱的女孩时产生变态的幻想。他仔细挑选自己的衣柜，阅读有关性的书籍，观看AV，为它出现的那一刻做好准备。尽管被道德委员会的铃鹿标记为麻烦制造者，但对他来说，学校生活仍然很愉快。当父母远在海外时，他在家并不感到孤独，因为他的妹妹心总是微笑着迎接他。

有一天，他帮助了一位自称来自未来的女孩Miku。她给了他一枚戒指，并告诉他如果想变得受欢迎就戴上它。确实，戴上它后，他的生活发生了变化，学校里所有的女孩都爱上了他，包括将他视为敌人的铃鹿。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/06/11/june-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
